Schezwan Fried Rice recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Tuesday, December 19, 2017 - 4:40am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Schezwan Fried Rice Masala
4 tbsp. of Oil
2 cups of Chopped Vegetables of your choice (cabbage, carrot, capsicum, onion, french beans, etc)
6 cups of Boiled Rice
Chopped spring onion for garnishing

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Heat 4 tbsp of oil in a pan & stir-fry 2 cups of chopped vegetables of your choice (carrot, capsicum, onion, cabbage, French beans, etc) for 2-3 minutes. 3 Step 2: 4 Add 6 cups of boiled rice (leftover rice from last night's dinner is perfect) to the vegetables. 5 Step 3: 6 Add Ching’s Secret Schezwan Masala & stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. 7 Your Schezwan Fried Rice is ready.

About

It is a Quick and Easy Schezwan Fried Rice Recipe that all food lovers love to eat it. Delicious Schezwan fried rice is popular Chinese rice made in just few minutes. The best combination of Indochinese cuisine, Schezwan fried rice is fully loaded with herbs and spices and Schezwan.
